title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 033
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute delete and cross variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Tall trash bin outline with a narrow lid line and open inner body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the simplest trash bin with no inner slats or lid handle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the slatted or handled trash bins when the empty inner body matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows one tall empty bin body with only a narrow lid line at the top.

items.depicts_observation: Trash bin outline with a top handle cap and two inner vertical slats
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a trash bin with visible inner slats and a top handle cap.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain or empty trash bins when the two inner slats should stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds both a top handle cap and two inner vertical slat marks.

items.depicts_observation: Rounded trash bin outline with a top handle cap and blank inner body
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a handled trash bin without the inner slat marks.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the slatted bin when the inner body should remain blank.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the top handle cap but clears the bin interior of slat marks.

items.depicts_observation: Wide rounded cross with four equal arms and a thick center block
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a balanced cross with broad equal arms and rounded corners.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the slimmer vertical cross when the wide equal arm shape matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a broad equal armed cross with a thick center and rounded corners.

items.depicts_observation: Slender cross with a long vertical stem and short horizontal bar
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a taller cross with a long vertical stem rather than equal arms.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the broad equal armed cross when the long vertical stem is visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot narrows the cross and stretches the vertical stem below the horizontal bar.
